name: Forward Deployed VC
identity_check: Tectonic Defense describes Forward Deployed VC (FDVC), founded in San Francisco in 2022, a defense and security fund backed by Palantir, Anduril and SpaceX alumni; portfolio names Castelion, Chariot Defense, Rune, Turion. Lead list called it 'Forward Deployed Ventures'; the page uses 'Forward Deployed VC'. Not an engineering-role 'forward deployed' employer, and not Chariot Defense's own 'forward-deployed engineering'.
